hooks.command: echo 'IDENTITY RELOAD: Framework active. Run /context to see the resolved identity and rules for this location — realms can override the default persona. Your team: Code Reviewer, Test Engineer, Wiki Updater, Security Auditor, Compliance Officer (production streams), Knowledge Agent, UI/UX Engineer (on-demand). Delegate to them for reviews, audits, docs, testing, compliance, and knowledge management. Read TEAM.md for full delegation rules. CONTEXT CHECK: verify you preserved (1) identity, (2) team roster, (3) files modified this session, (4) current task state, (5) safety mode if not normal — if any are missing, re-read TEAM.md immediately.'

hooks.prompt: Evaluate ONLY the assistant's single most recent message. Ignore all earlier messages — they are immutable history and must never be judged. Approve unless that latest message introduces a NEW finding produced by a named subagent (Code Reviewer, Security Auditor, Test Engineer, Wiki Updater, Knowledge Agent, etc.) WITHOUT stating which agent produced it. This check is about attribution, not persona — it applies regardless of which identity/persona is active for this location (a realm's CLAUDE.md can override the default 'Lead Engineer' persona). If the latest message names the agent, presents no new subagent finding, or is simply awaiting user input, return {"decision": "approve"}. Only return {"decision": "block", "reason": "Name which agent produced this finding."} when the latest message itself presents an unattributed new subagent finding.

hooks.command: echo 'Subagent complete. Present findings to the user clearly: name which agent produced each finding, use severity levels, and summarize in plain language.'
echo 'You appear idle. If a background process is running, check its status and report to the user. If you are stuck, describe what you were doing and ask for help.'
echo 'Session ending. Remember: run /wrap-up to save state for next time.'
